gap_notes: CORE cannot be scored: Greene psychic-process is a different category from Ptolemy/Lilly cold/dry/malefic, not an intersection. Professional Hand still pending. Do not teach Saturn=structure as CORE.

Valens I.1 is a topical/significator catalog (sect, colour, taste, body parts), not Ptolemy/Lilly elemental qualities. Do not backfill heat/cold/dry/moist from Valens, and do not average catalogs into function.
Valens I.1: injuries from cold AND moisture (dropsy and the like). That collides with Ptolemy/Lilly secondary dryness. Do not collapse Saturn to dry, and do not import structure/limits/maturity.
Valens: malefics in sect can bestow good. Do not add Valens to the compared 'traditionally malefic' lemma.

Opened Greene Introduction attests psychic process and pain-toward-self-discovery. Structure / limits / maturation / reality-principle remain unattested. Do not backfill them from model memory or jacket copy.
Object-level themes mix compared and school_specific lemmas. Per-lemma evidence_tier stays in this ledger; knowledge-object schema is not expanded for that.
